config.label: Wontopos API key (wos-live-
config.description: Wontopos API key (wos-live-...). Create one in the console at wontopos.com.

config.label: Default store for every tool call (default: "default")
config.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").

config.label: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, scroll-1
config.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, scroll-1.2, or scroll-2.

config.label: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0)
config.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.

config.label: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0)
config.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.

config.label: A different API host
config.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.

config.label: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000)
config.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.

config.label: Set to 1 for read-only mode: only the tools that read are registered, no write or delete tools
config.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: only the tools that read are registered, no write or delete tools.

config.label: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store)
config.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.

config.label: Set to 0 to leave the assistant's own lines out of every working memory, or 1 to keep them
config.description: Set to 0 to leave the assistant's own lines out of every working memory, or 1 to keep them. Default: off on S-2-live, on on S-2.

config.label: The diversity each working memory asks for: none, mmr, temporal or full
config.description: The diversity each working memory asks for: none, mmr, temporal or full. Default: full on S-2-live, unset on S-2.

config.label: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process
config.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.

config.label: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry
config.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.

config.label: Interface to bind in HTTP mode
config.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).

config.label: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name
config.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.

config.label: Your UTC offset in hours, such as 9 or -4 (default: this machine's clock over stdio, none over HTTP)
config.description: Your UTC offset in hours, such as 9 or -4 (default: this machine's clock over stdio, none over HTTP).

config.label: The store's time zone, an IANA name such as America/New_York, set once if the store has none
config.description: The store's time zone, an IANA name such as America/New_York, set once if the store has none.

config.label: The name the user's words are stored under, set once if the store has none
config.description: The name the user's words are stored under, set once if the store has none.

config.label: The name the assistant's replies are stored under, set once if the store has none
config.description: The name the assistant's replies are stored under, set once if the store has none.

config.label: The working-memory tools' preset
config.description: The working-memory tools' preset. S-2-live (scroll-2) is for everyday conversation: its first look searches with the question and the last two lines said in the last five minutes, leaves out the assistant's own lines and asks for full diversity. S-2 (scroll-2) is for measuring memory performance: it answers one question at a time, as a benchmark asks. They run on its model (default: the preset of WONTOPOS_MODEL, S-2-live on scroll-2).

config.label: Set to 1 so working-memory lines say who said each (default off)
config.description: Set to 1 so working-memory lines say who said each (default off).

config.label: Set to 1 to offer timeline, the memories held with dates (default off)
config.description: Set to 1 to offer timeline, the memories held with dates (default off).

config.label: Set to 1 so working memory brings up photos, shown with look_at_photo (default off)
config.description: Set to 1 so working memory brings up photos, shown with look_at_photo (default off).

config.label: Set to 1 so think_back brings the core and box names a sleep wrote, and open_box opens a box (default off)
config.description: Set to 1 so think_back brings the core and box names a sleep wrote, and open_box opens a box (default off).

config.label: Set to 1 to offer memory_recent, the recent conversation, and memory_seen, what was held for a line (default off)
config.description: Set to 1 to offer memory_recent, the recent conversation, and memory_seen, what was held for a line (default off).

config.label: The ask tool's router: anthropic (default) or openai, for any OpenAI-compatible server
config.description: The ask tool's router: anthropic (default) or openai, for any OpenAI-compatible server.

config.label: The router's key, sent to the router's server only (required for anthropic)
config.description: The router's key, sent to the router's server only (required for anthropic).

config.label: The router's API base (anthropic: https://api
config.description: The router's API base (anthropic: https://api.anthropic.com by default; openai: required).

config.label: The router's model (anthropic: claude-haiku-5-5 by default; openai: required)
config.description: The router's model (anthropic: claude-haiku-5-5 by default; openai: required).

config.label: The skills' API, anthropic or openai (default: the router's)
config.description: The skills' API, anthropic or openai (default: the router's).

config.label: The skills' key (default: the router's, when the skills use the router's server)
config.description: The skills' key (default: the router's, when the skills use the router's server).

config.label: The skills' API base (default: the router's)
config.description: The skills' API base (default: the router's).

config.label: The skills' model (default: the router's)
config.description: The skills' model (default: the router's).

config.label: An exportSkills JSON file: the skills of the configured store, for the ask tool
config.description: An exportSkills JSON file: the skills of the configured store, for the ask tool.
